description: Local-only Agentlas context recall plus dependency impact before mutations.

hooks.command: R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" --host claude --event SessionStart; else printf '{}\n'; fi
R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" --host claude --event UserPromptSubmit; else printf '{}\n'; fi

R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-one-drawer-guard" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-one-drawer-guard" --host claude; else printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The One drawer guard is missing; refusing the write until it is restored."}}'; fi
R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-memory-hook" --host claude --event PreToolUse; else printf '{}\n'; fi
R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" --host claude --event SubagentStart; else printf '{}\n'; fi
R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-subagent-hook" --host claude --event SubagentStop; else printf '{}\n'; fi
R=$(printf %s "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" | tr '\\' '/'); if [ -x "$R/bin/agentlas-one" ]; then "$R/bin/agentlas-one" stop-hook; else printf '{}\n'; fi
